modelNotes: Assists Board 1.0 uses season assists, last 5 assists, last 10 assists, expected minutes, minutes confidence, usage, position role, and recent assist trend.
Assists Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent assist rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Antetokounmpo is probable for Tuesday's game against the Jazz due to a right wrist sprain.
injury.detail: Antetokounmpo has found his way onto the injury report over Miami's last few matchups due to a wrist issue, but he's yet to miss any time. That trend looks like it will continue Tuesday in Utah.

injury.shortComment: Sabonis (knee) is questionable to play Tuesday's game against the Magic.
injury.detail: Sabonis missed Sunday's 114-108 loss to the Heat with left knee soreness, making it his first absence of the season through 10 games. Dylan Cardwell earned the start with Sabonis sidelined, so if the latter is forced to miss a second straight contest, the former would be the top candidate to start once again.

injury.shortComment: Herro (contusion) is listed as questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks.
injury.detail: Herro exited to the locker room during Sunday's loss to the Celtics after suffering an apparent knee injury, though he later returned to the game. However, he's since been added to the injury report with a contusion. If the veteran guard is ultimately ruled out for the front end of this back-to-back set, Brayden Burries and Ryan Rollins would likely see expanded roles. AJ Green could also see increased playing time if Herro is ruled out.

injury.shortComment: Hart is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Bucks due to right ankle soreness.
injury.detail: Hart is aiming to avoid missing a third straight contest with the issue. Once Hart is ready to return to the court, Landry Shamet will likely revert back to his typical role off the bench.

injury.shortComment: Markkanen (wrist) is questionable for Tuesday's game against Miami.
injury.detail: Markkanen was held out Sunday due to a right wrist sprain, but the fact that he's been upgraded to questionable is a positive sign. Utah should have another update on the forward's availability closer to tipoff.

injury.shortComment: Murray is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Magic due to right wrist soreness.
injury.detail: Murray made his return to court Sunday against Miami following a seven-game absence due to an ankle injury, and it now appears he's dealing with a wrist issue. The Kings will presumably monitor him closely during shootaround and warmups to determine if he can suit up Tuesday.

injury.shortComment: Christie is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Suns due to a right ankle sprain, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
injury.detail: Christie could be in street clothes for Tuesday's action, which would hurt the Clippers' depth off the bench. His status is unlikely to have a major impact on the rotation, though.
